Single Cell RNA-seq Workshop

Welcome to the Center for Biomedical Data Science Single Cell RNA-seq Workshop — a hands-on, three-day workshop that takes you end-to-end through a modern single-cell RNA-seq analysis: from count matrices through quality control, clustering, cell-type annotation, multi-sample integration, and differential expression. By the end you’ll be able to produce and interpret a figure like the clustered UMAP above. The workshop is sponsored by the Center for Biomedical Data Science (CBDS) at the University of Oregon.

This site hosts everything the workshop runs on — lecture slides, hands-on tutorials, datasets, and reference material — and it stays online as a free, living resource for your continued learning long after the workshop ends.

Use the navigation bar above to reach the schedule, software setup, all workshop materials, and additional resources.
